mapper.select: SELECT cinema_id AS cinemaId, city_id AS cityId, name, address, lat, lng, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM cinema ORDER BY name LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cinema (cinema_id, city_id, name, address, lat, lng, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{cinema.cinemaId}, #{cinema.cityId}, #{cinema.name}, #{cinema.address}, #{cinema.lat}, #{cinema.lng}, #{cinema.createdAt}, #{cinema.updatedAt})
